name: longest line
perl: perl -ne '$m = $_ if length > length $m; END { print $m }'
awk: gawk 'length > length(m) { m = $0 } END { print m }'

name: sum a named CSV column
jet: jet -e 'Sale: struct { amount: Float }; input.csv<Sale>().map((s) -> s.amount).sum()'
perl: perl -F, -lane 'if ($. == 1) { ($c) = grep { $F[$_] eq "amount" } 0 .. $#F } else { $s += $F[$c] } END { print $s }'
awk: gawk -F, 'NR == 1 { for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i == "amount") c = i; next } { s += $c } END { print s }'
